mapper.sql: o.id, o.order_no, o.status, o.store_id, s.store_name, o.return_store_id, rs.store_name AS return_store_name, o.start_date, o.end_date, o.rent_days, o.vehicle_count, o.rent_amount, o.deposit_amount, o.total_amount, o.credit_level_snapshot, o.deposit_coefficient, o.overdue_days, o.create_time, o.pay_time, u.username AS customer_username, u.real_name AS customer_name, u.phone AS customer_phone, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(oi.vehicle_name SEPARATOR ' / ') FROM order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.id) AS vehicle_names, (SELECT COALESCE(vi.image_url, m2.cover_image) FROM order_item oi JOIN vehicle v ON v.id = oi.vehicle_id JOIN vehicle_model m2 ON m2.id = v.model_id LEFT JOIN vehicle_image vi ON vi.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE oi.order_id = o.id ORDER BY oi.id, vi.sort_no, vi.id LIMIT 1) AS cover_image, (SELECT oi.vehicle_id FROM order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.id ORDER BY oi.id LIMIT 1) AS first_vehicle_id
mapper.select: SELECT , o.remark, o.cancel_reason, o.cancel_time, o.pickup_time, o.return_apply_time, o.return_time, o.finish_time, o.late_fee, o.deposit_refund_status, o.credit_score_snapshot, u.credit_score AS customer_credit_score, u.credit_level AS customer_credit_level FROM lease_order o LEFT JOIN store s ON s.id = o.store_id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN store rs ON rs.id = o.return_store_id AND rs.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = o.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE o.id = #{orderId} AND o.deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(o.status = 'WAIT_PAY'), 0) AS pending_pay, COALESCE(SUM(o.status = 'WAIT_PICKUP'), 0) AS pending_pickup, COALESCE(SUM(o.status IN ('IN_USE', 'WAIT_RETURN', 'OVERDUE')), 0) AS in_use, COALESCE(SUM(o.status = 'OVERDUE'), 0) AS overdue, COALESCE(SUM(o.create_time >= CURDATE()), 0) AS today_new, COALESCE(SUM(o.late_fee), 0) AS late_fee_total FROM lease_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0
